_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in the values below. config.json is gitignored.
_home_url_fragment_comment: A substring of the URL Brightspace redirects you to once SSO login succeeds (e.g. '/d2l/home'). Used to detect that login is complete.
_output_dir_comment: Where downloaded syllabi land. Defaults to ~/Desktop/Syllabi if omitted or null.
_student_role_id_comment: Optional, for --requester. Speeds up looking up someone's enrollment log by asking Brightspace to only return their student-role courses server-side, instead of fetching every course they have any role on (slow for admin/staff accounts). Filled in automatically the first time --requester runs while this is null -- no manual editing needed.
